heading_en: Propose it, and talk it through first
display_fil:
Magkaibang sagot sa dalawang pagbisita
Isang tanong na kailangang linawin
Pag-usapan bago magbago.
display_en:
Different answers on two visits
One question to clarify
Discuss before changing.
narration_fil: Sa dalawang pagbisita, magkaiba ang narinig ni BHW Vlanche sa mga residente tungkol sa kung sino ang lalapitan para sa tanong sa health station. “Sino po ba ang dapat kong tanungin?” sabi ni Mang Ernesto. Itinala ni Vlanche ang tanong nang walang pangalan o personal na detalye. Hindi pa nito pinatutunayang mali ang buong sistema. May puwang na dapat linawin kasama ang kapwa BHW at midwife bago magmungkahi ng pagbabago.
narration_en: On two visits, BHW Vlanche hears residents give different answers about whom to approach with a health station question. “Who should I ask?” says Mang Ernesto. Vlanche notes the question without names or personal details. This does not establish that the whole system is wrong. It identifies something to clarify with a fellow BHW and the midwife before proposing a change.

display_fil:
Isang maikling mensahe
Mga nakatakdang pagbisita sa susunod na linggo
Panukala muna; tiyakin bago gamitin.
display_en:
One short message
Scheduled visits next week
Propose first; confirm before using.
narration_fil: Mungkahi ni Vlanche: “Sa mga pagbisita ko sa susunod na linggo, maaari kaya tayong gumamit ng isang maikling mensahe tungkol sa kung sino ang tatanungin?” Maliit ang simula: isang mensahe sa mga nakatakdang pagbisita, hindi isang buong kampanya. Panukala pa lamang ito. Bago gamitin, kailangan niyang tiyakin ang impormasyon, kausapin ang midwife, at alamin kung pasok ang gawain sa kanyang papel at oras. Maaaring baguhin ang mungkahi pagkatapos ng usapan.
narration_en: Vlanche proposes: “On my visits next week, could we use one short message about whom to ask?” The starting point is small: one message during scheduled visits, rather than a whole campaign. It is still a proposal. Before using it, she needs to confirm the information, discuss it with the midwife, and check that the task fits her role and time. The proposal may change after that discussion.

display_fil:
Kasalukuyang contact?
May umiiral na mensahe o patakaran?
Linawin ang hindi pa tiyak.
display_en:
Current contact?
Existing message or policy?
Clarify what is still uncertain.
narration_fil: Tinanong ni Vlanche ang midwife: “Sino ang kasalukuyang contact para sa ganitong tanong? May mensahe na ba tayong ginagamit?” Maaaring may bagong iskedyul o lokal na patakaran na hindi pa niya alam. Pinakinggan niya ang paliwanag at mungkahi ng kapwa BHW. Kung hindi pa kumpirmado ang contact o mensahe, hindi muna niya ito ipapakalat. Ipapalinaw muna sa taong may pananagutan. Hindi binabago ng BHW ang serbisyo o patakaran sa sariling pasya.
narration_en: Vlanche asks the midwife: “Who is the current contact for this kind of question? Do we already have a message?” There may be a new schedule or local policy she does not yet know about. She listens to the explanation and her fellow BHW’s suggestion. If the contact or message is unconfirmed, she holds it back and asks the responsible person to clarify it. A BHW does not change services or policy on their own.

display_fil:
Gawain: kumpirmadong maikling mensahe
Tao at gamit: Vlanche; gabay na sinuri ng midwife
Balikan: Biyernes; natitirang tanong.
display_en:
Action: confirmed short message
Person and material: Vlanche; midwife-checked guide
Review: Friday; remaining questions.
narration_fil: Sa halimbawang ito, napagkasunduan nila ang plano matapos kumpirmahin ng midwife ang contact at mensahe. Si Vlanche ang magsasabi nito sa kanyang nakatakdang pagbisita sa susunod na linggo. Gagamit siya ng maliit na gabay na sinuri ng midwife; hindi kailangan ng bagong kampanya o dagdag na serbisyong hindi napagkasunduan. Sa Biyernes, babalikan nila ang mga tanong na hindi pa malinaw. Isulat: ano ang gagawin, sino ang responsable at kailangang pumayag, anong oras at materyales ang kaya, at kailan susuriin ang resulta.
narration_en: In this example, they agree on a plan after the midwife confirms the contact and message. Vlanche will explain it during her scheduled visits next week. She will use a small guide checked by the midwife; the plan needs no new campaign or unagreed service. On Friday, they will review questions that remain unclear. Write down the action, the responsible person and required agreement, the time and materials available, and when to review the result.

heading_en: Try it and review what happened
display_fil:
Masabi ba ang tamang contact?
Anong tanong ang nanatili?
Balikan kasama ang midwife; ayusin kung kailangan.
display_en:
Can people name the correct contact?
What questions remain?
Review with the midwife; revise if needed.
narration_fil: Sa napagkasunduang pagsubok, tinanong ni Vlanche pagkatapos ng paliwanag: “Sino po ang lalapitan ninyo para sa ganitong tanong?” Itinala niya kung ilang nakausap ang nakapagsabi ng tamang contact at kung anong tanong ang nanatili, nang walang personal na detalye. Sa Biyernes, tiningnan nila ng midwife ang tala at feedback. Kung hindi malinaw ang mensahe, aayusin nila ito bago muling subukan. Ang ilang sagot ay palatandaan lamang; hindi patunay na gumanda na ang buong sistema o kalusugan ng lahat.
narration_en: During the agreed trial, Vlanche asks after explaining: “Who would you approach with this kind of question?” She notes how many people can name the correct contact and what questions remain, without personal details. On Friday, she and the midwife review the notes and feedback. If the message is unclear, they revise it before trying again. A few answers are a small indicator; they do not prove that the whole system or everyone’s health has improved.

check.prompt_fil: Magkaiba ang sagot ng mga residente kung sino ang tatanungin sa health station. Aling plano ang dapat munang ihanda ni Vlanche?
check.prompt_en: Residents give different answers about whom to ask at the health station. Which plan should Vlanche prepare first?

options.fil: Gumawa ng paalalang may pangakong libre ang lahat ng serbisyo upang mahikayat ang mga residente.
options.en: Prepare a reminder promising every service is free to encourage residents.

options.fil: Tiyakin sa midwife ang contact at mensahe, magkasundo sa kayang pagbisita sa susunod na linggo at gamit, saka balikan sa Biyernes kung masabi ng mga nakausap ang contact at kung may tanong pa.
options.en: Confirm the contact and message with the midwife, agree on feasible visits next week and materials, then review on Friday whether people can name the contact and what questions remain.

options.fil: Palitan agad ang proseso ng health station at ipaalam na lamang ito sa midwife pagkatapos.
options.en: Change the health station process immediately and inform the midwife afterwards.

options.fil: Ipanukalang pagbutihin ang lahat ng gawain, saka na isipin kung sino, kailan, at paano susuriin.
options.en: Propose improving all activities and decide who, when, and how to review later.

check.feedback_fil: Ang ikalawang plano ang maisasagawa: may kumpirmadong impormasyon at pahintulot, maliit na gawain, kayang oras at gamit, at palatandaang babalikan. Walang batayan ang pangakong lahat ay libre; ang pagpapalit ng proseso nang mag-isa ay lampas sa napagkasunduan; ang “pagbutihin ang lahat” ay kulang sa konkretong hakbang.
check.feedback_en: The second plan is workable: it has confirmed information and agreement, a small action, feasible time and materials, and an indicator to review. The blanket free-service promise is unsupported; changing the process alone exceeds the agreement; “improve everything” lacks a concrete first step.

narration_fil: May mungkahi kang gawing mas malinaw ang impormasyon sa mga pagbisita. Bago magsimula, kailangan ng kumpirmadong contact at mensahe, tamang pahintulot, at kayang oras at gamit. Pagkatapos, kailangan mong malaman kung naunawaan ito at kung ano pa ang dapat ayusin. Piliin ang plano na may maliit na unang hakbang at malinaw na pagbabalik sa health team. Sa iyong barangay, ano ang isang totoong puwang, sino ang dapat mong kausapin, at ano ang una mong ipapalinaw?
narration_en: You have an idea to make information clearer during visits. Before starting, you need a confirmed contact and message, the right agreement, and feasible time and materials. Afterwards, you need to check whether people understood it and what still needs adjustment. Choose the plan with a small first step and a clear review with the health team. In your barangay, what is one real gap, whom should you discuss it with, and what would you clarify first?
